notes.title: God, Save the Queens! After 1 Year of Development!
notes.content:
"God, Save the Queens!" is a 2.5D wave-based Rogue-like where you are God who came down to rescue Arthur III, the King of Provia's five daughters from the evil empires. Kill thousands of enemies, upgrade your skills, unlock new weapons, and save the queens!

[b]Here are some screenshots of the current state of the game:[/b]
